$comment: Packages whose upstream publishes no licence text, only an SPDX identifier in package.json. That identifier is the grant, and there is no text to reproduce — inventing one would be worse than citing the declaration. Every entry needs a reason, so this stays an audited exception rather than a silent pass. scripts/third-party-notices.mjs reads this file.

@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm.reason: Neither the published package nor its GitHub repository (checked on master and main) contains a licence file.
@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm.ifThisMatters: @jspawn/qpdf-wasm ships qpdf's Apache-2.0 text, but its ESM wrapper mutates globalThis and fights the bundler — see ADR 0003. Switching is the fallback if a customer's legal review rejects a declaration-only dependency.
